## Analysis Tab

The Analysis tab displays different component breakdown data depending on whether the meter is a hydrocarbon or non-hydrocarbon meter. The tab also displays sample data, such as sample date, absolute density, and molar mass.

### Hydrocarbon Meters

For hydrocarbon meters, the tab displays the component breakdown for Mole %, Mass % and Liquid Volume % as well as extended characterization values for samples with a C6+, C7+, C8+, C9+, or C10+.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 616;height: 406;" />

### Non-Hydrocarbon Meters

For non-hydrocarbon meters, the tab displays the non-hydrocarbon component breakdown for NHC Mass%, NHC Mole %, and NHC Liquid Volume %.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 619;height: 403;" />
